collection.title: VW Beetle Cabriolet 2003 to 2010 Windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: A VW Beetle 2003 to 2010 model requires a 21" wiper blade for both the drivers and the passengers side with a Standard Hook arm attachment. All of the following wiper blades are designed to fit this vehicle.
